specific_objectives: 19.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to describe details about Engineering Metrology.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of slip gauge handling, cleaning, and storage; Safety: Handle with tissue, avoid dropping; Supervision: Instructor monitors technique
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of slip gauges in metrology?
Name two common materials used to manufacture slip gauges.
Why must slip gauges be handled with clean hands or tissue?

topics: Definition and function of slip gauges
development.content:
Introduction to Engineering Metrology
Definition and function of slip gauges
Historical context of gauge blocks
Basic terminology and nomenclature
Importance of precision in measurements

Indian Standards for slip gauges
Material composition and properties
Grades and tolerances (Grade 0 to 3)
Surface finish and flatness requirements
Standard sizes and series available

Proper handling techniques
Cleaning and maintenance procedures
Storage methods and environmental control
Common errors and damage prevention
Inspection and verification practices

summary_questions: Explain the difference between Grade 0 and Grade 3 slip gauges in terms of accuracy.
Describe the correct method for wiping a slip gauge before use.
Why is it critical to store slip gauges in a controlled environment?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how the principles of slip gauge usage apply to the upcoming lesson on dial indicators (LP 07), focusing on precision measurement continuity.
